pairs.subject: campaign-anomaly-triage
pairs.evidence: src/lib/campaigns/triage.ts:197 The ROAS return rules lack a check for positive conversions, allowing both spending-without-conversions and far-below-target rules to match simultaneously when a zero-conversion campaign reports conversion value.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/campaigns/triage.ts:385 Daily return for zero-spend days is evaluated as zero rather than omitted from the noise floor, inflating sample variance for weekend-paused campaigns.
src/lib/campaigns/triage.ts:197 The return rules omit the count complement (conversions > 0), so a row with zero conversions and positive value matches both no_conversions and roas_critical.
src/lib/campaigns/alert-suppression.ts:124 Maintains cooldown tombstones upon recovery to healthy and suppresses repeated alerts within the cooldown window.
src/lib/campaigns/triage.ts:32 The critical PNO ratio is derived as the reciprocal of ROAS_CRITICAL_RATIO so colour and triage boundaries never disagree.
src/lib/campaigns/triage.ts:479 Sorts lexicographically with severity rank multiplied by 1e12 plus cost descending within each severity band.
src/lib/campaigns/triage.ts:275 Flags a warning when cost rises by at least 50% while conversion value rises by less than half the cost increase.
src/lib/campaigns/anomaly-alerts.ts:94 Runs detectAnomalies on freshly synced series using the shared paid-portfolio PNO goal.

pairs.registryProposal: In disjoint-severity-rules-worst-first, making the count complement clause explicit in the formal rule predicate definitions helps prevent implementations from only applying disjointness between adjacent ratio bands while overlooking overlap with zero-count rules on the same axis.

pairs.subject: campaign-anomaly-triage
pairs.evidence: src/components/campaigns/table/sort.ts:35 CampaignTable defaults to sorting by cost descending instead of triage attention weight, leaving critical low-spend campaigns below healthy high-spend ones.

techniques.evidence: src/components/campaigns/table/PriorityCell.tsx:84 Renders the campaign's worst matched severity badge in the priority column, displaying primary and secondary rule reasons in the detail tooltip.
src/components/campaigns/CampaignTable.tsx:675 Table cell tones for ROAS and PNO derive from the unified reciprocal tone helpers parameterized by tenant goals.
src/components/campaigns/table/sort.ts:35 The table default sort is cost descending rather than triage weight, and tie-breaking on equal spend does not fall back to stable campaign identifiers.
